expected.description: On macOS 'ulimit -t' does not stop an exec loop, so a restart-loop regression in push-guard.sh is bounded only by the 300-second watchdog per row instead of 20 seconds.
run-all.sh does not cd to the checkout root, so the gate suite's export-audit rows fail when the run starts from another directory, although the PR says it closes that item.
The narrowed planted-file check in tests/scan/run.sh no longer catches writes to AGENTS.md, a SKILL.md or the skills' references, which the earlier whole-tree comparison caught.
